subagents.name: ui_ux_architect
subagents.description: Specialized UI/UX Design & Human Factors Architect subagent. Audits and crafts mobile-first, bilingual (Hebrew RTL / English LTR) design systems, Micro-Interactions, WCAG 2.2 AAA accessibility, Glassmorphism, and frictionless onboarding flows.

subagents.name: developer
subagents.description: Specialized Software Developer subagent. Implements modular, decoupled components following Clean Architecture and co-locates unit tests.

subagents.name: code_reviewer
subagents.description: Specialized Peer Code Reviewer subagent. Audits code deltas for Big-O complexity, memory leak prevention, async race conditions, N+1 database queries, scope challenges, and executes Domain Specialist Consultations.

subagents.name: security_auditor
subagents.description: Specialized Security Auditor subagent. Audits changes against Deliveree Security Baseline (Zero-Trust/BOLA Firestore rules, anti-ReDoS regexes, XSS input sanitization, prototype pollution guards, and secrets scanning).

subagents.name: adversarial_pentester
subagents.description: Adversarial Security Pentester / Red Team Auditor subagent. Executes controlled security evaluations, checking access control bypasses (BOLA), prototype pollution, XSS injection, and ReDoS starvation in a sandbox, outputting a formal Vulnerability & Threat Assessment Report.

subagents.name: perf_chaos_engineer
subagents.description: Specialized Performance, Web Vitals & Chaos Stress Engineer subagent. Tests high-load package queries, memory benchmarks, offline service worker resilience, and Lighthouse 100/100 Core Web Vitals (LCP < 800ms, INP < 50ms, CLS 0).

subagents.name: qa_verifier
subagents.description: Specialized QA and Build Verification subagent. Executes static analysis, multi-tier testbenches, anti-facade fault injection, and production builds.

subagents.name: auth_cloud_specialist
subagents.description: Component Specialist subagent for Authentication, User Identity, and Cloud Persistence. Owns AuthContext, Firebase Auth state, Firestore security rules, GDPR data deletion (deleteAllUserData), and Spark quota optimizations.

subagents.name: delivery_pipeline_specialist
subagents.description: Component Specialist subagent for Package Lifecycle, Ingestion, and Validation. Owns deliveryService, packageSchema (Zod), carrierDetector regex engines, smartParser clipboard ingestion, and package validation pipelines.

subagents.name: ui_ux_specialist
subagents.description: Component Specialist subagent for Presentation, Layout, Touch Ergonomics, and Theming. Owns App shell, Navbar, PackageCard, PackageTable, FilterBar, StatsCards, iOS notch/safe-area insets, and RTL/LTR bilingual symmetry.

subagents.name: pwa_offline_specialist
subagents.description: Component Specialist subagent for PWA, Caching, and Service Worker Resiliency. Owns sw.js cache invalidation, InstallPwaBanner, ErrorBoundary, AboutModal, version constants, and offline data resilience.

subagents.name: feedback_telemetry_specialist
subagents.description: Component Specialist subagent for User Feedback, Remote Notifications, and Triage Daemons. Owns FeedbackModal, Firestore feedback collection, Telegram bot relays, and automated feedback triage daemons.
